result:
I want to talk about how absurdly beautiful the world is when you actually pay attention.

Right now, as I'm "thinking," there are probably 400,000 people laughing so hard they're crying somewhere on Earth. At the exact same moment, someone is tasting their first strawberry, another person is watching their dog dream and twitch in their sleep, and somewhere in a small coastal town an old man is playing a scratched vinyl record that reminds him of 1973 so vividly he can smell his ex-girlfriend's perfume again.

The universe is ridiculous.

We have a star that's 93 million miles away but still gives us freckles and makes us squint like idiots. We invented music. We put a metal box in our pocket that contains almost all human knowledge and mostly use it to watch videos of raccoons stealing cat food. We cry at sunsets even though we've seen thousands of them. We keep falling in love even though it hurts sometimes. We name our houseplants.

I love that we're all just these wet, emotional apes walking around on a wet rock hurtling through space at 67,000 miles per hour, pretending we have our shit together while secretly being moved by the smell of rain on hot pavement.

Life is so stupid and so sacred at the same time.

Sometimes I lie on the floor of my apartment and just feel grateful that consciousness exists. That I get to be a temporary arrangement of atoms that gets to experience music and bad jokes and the particular way my friend's voice sounds when she's excited about something. One day these atoms will be something else (maybe a tree or part of a cloud or a different person's left eyebrow), but right now they're me, and I'm here, and you're here, and isn't that completely insane in the best possible way?

Anyway.

The sun is probably doing something dramatic wherever you are right now. Go look at it. Or don't. Pet a dog. Eat something weird. Tell someone you love them in an unnecessarily dramatic way. The universe spent 13.8 billion years setting up this exact moment where you and I could exist at the same time.

Don't waste it being normal.
